scope: Independent mathematical/scope review of root-authored CantrellSupports, certificate37-authored CantrellBranch, Angle interface, ResearchTarget and HTML report snapshot. This reviewer authored Minimax and PackingGeometry, so this is not an independent audit of those two modules. FinalBridge is excluded because root is still writing it.
verdict: No blocking mathematical defect found in the reviewed support/branch statements. The report already correctly distinguishes a certified upper bound, a conditional support-model lower bound, and unresolved global optimality/exact endpoint feasibility.

checks.result: The 13 explicit fields telescope to support gap 3+c+s. The wall/axis chains yield dx<=L-4 and reversed dy<=L-3. Nonnegative weights s,c give 3+4c+5s<=(c+s)L with the reported coefficients.

Left projections give U>=c+3s+3/2-sL and V>=s+2c+3/2. Nonnegative weights c-s,c+s and c^2+s^2=1 yield floor=3+3c+s(c-s)(5-L). Explicit coordinate reflection and two diagonal gaps yield the reported second inequality.
rightLabels maps only the five labels used by LeftBrace. No global permutation or mirror symmetry of an arbitrary packing is assumed or proved.

For the two common grain directions with 0<=s<=c, unnormalized (1,1) support of a unit square is c; for an exact 45-degree unit square it is sqrt(2)/2. Thus both stated central inequalities have the correct coefficient.
Branch uses d=1+q^2>0. c+s=(1+2q-q^2)/d and 2*(1+s*(c-s))=secondDenominator(q)/d^2. Denominators are proved positive in the relevant range. Multiplying inequalities does not reverse their signs.

Angle.half_angle_representation covers every single shared unit direction satisfying 0<=s<=c, with q in [0,sqrt(2)-1]. It does not cover arbitrary independent directions of all 37 squares or arbitrary separating-axis choices.

The HTML Q(L,r), degree-eight P(L), and even half-angle polynomial match the Lean definitions. The stated broad isolating interval matches candidateSide_strict_interval. The much tighter decimal interval is explicitly labeled as separately computed rather than Lean-replayed.

The report correctly gives Lrat=659861960924437/10^14 as the Lean feasible side and explicitly says the algebraic endpoint layout is unproved. Neither Angle support equalities nor minimax proves that 37 complete squares fit at the exact endpoint.

ResearchTarget defines GlobalLowerBound and ExactEndpointFeasible separately and proves only their equivalence to GlobalOptimality. No proof of either missing premise is supplied or smuggled into the feasible upper bound.
The report explicitly marks T154 as a source/interface audit without complete local reconstruction and mentions all 13343 native_decide facts; no independent replay is claimed.
